label: US-CA-AB1979-2026 SECTION 1.

obligations.text: (a)A health facility, clinic, physician’s office, or office of a group practice shall take reasonable steps to ensure that a licensed health care provider, acting within their scope of practice, retains the ability to exercise independent professional judgment in their care of a patient whenever that care is informed by the output of a clinical decision support system.
